fact: Burkina Faso's National TB Programme introduced the CAD4TB AI reader on its mobile X-ray units in 2024; between September 2024 and April 2025 it screened 1,730 people, CAD4TB flagged 50 suspected cases, 37 confirmed by AI and pulmonologist, and 13 of 50 were not TB.
title: Advancing TB screening in Burkina Faso with portable X-ray and CAD4TB
